s:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are incorrect? Bem
a. Prolaraja bore the title Arikesari. aes. siete
b. Nayankara system was introduced by Prataparudra.
c. Beta Il was initiated into Saivism by Rameswara Pandita of Srisailam
x:
Statement (a) is incorrect. Prolaraja II did not bear the title Arikesari. "Arikesari" was a title associated with other Deccan rulers and not with Prolaraja. Hence this statement is incorrect. Statement (b) is correct. The Nayankara System, under which military chiefs were assigned land in return for military service, was introduced during the reign of Prataparudra II. This system was later adopted and extensively developed by the Vijayanagara rulers. Statement (c) is correct. Beta II, an early Kakatiya ruler, embraced Shaivism under the influence of Rameswara Pandita of Srisailam. This marked the gradual transition of the Kakatiya rulers from Jainism to Shaivism.
Therefore, only Statement (a) is incorrect, making
Option (3) the correct answer.
n: Nayankara System – Introduced by Prataparudra II.
Early Kakatiyas – Initially Jains, later became Shaivites.

s: During the rule of Sri Krishnadevaraya, the 'Kandacharya' department looked into these matters?
x:
During the Vijayanagara administration, the Kandacharya was an important official connected with the military department. The Kandacharya supervised military organization, recruitment, maintenance of troops, inspection of armed forces and other defence-related responsibilities. Since the Vijayanagara Empire maintained a powerful standing army, this office occupied an important place in the administrative system. The military strength of the empire was one of the major reasons for its success against the Bahmani Sultanate and other contemporary powers.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).

Meruka was a commercial tax levied on the sale and purchase of goods during the Reddy period. Trade and commerce formed an important source of state revenue, and taxes like Meruka were imposed on market transactions carried out by merchants.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (4).
n: Meruka – Tax on Sale and Purchase
